body:

### 🐛 问题描述

我想接入混元模型，就先测试了一下。出现报错：
```json
{
  "error": {
    "id": "75dd945dd905ae9d84a22cbad69bc57d",
    "message": "请求格式有误",
    "type": "runtime_error",
    "param": null,
    "code": "4003"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1",
  "provider": "hunyuan"
}
```

说是请求格式有误
